entities.summary: John Phillips is an American former professional football tight end who played in the National Football League (NFL) for the Dallas Cowboys, San Diego Chargers, Denver Broncos, New Orleans Saints and Arizona Cardinals. He played college football for the Virginia Cavaliers and was selected by the Cowboys in the sixth round of the 2009 NFL draft.
